title: Lunch & Learn
intro: A Lunch & Learn is a format, and this page is an invitation to copy it. Take one design question your team keeps arguing about, build every competing answer for real, and run them side by side. Nothing here is mocked: every request you see really happens and every number is measured while you watch. Learn by doing: run it, slow something down, switch something off, and see what each pattern costs instead of taking a slide's word for it.
footer: Lesson switches you turn on switch themselves off when you leave the page.

topics.title: Sequential vs Parallel Requests
topics.summary: A page needs three independent answers from the server. Ask for them one after another, or all at once? Both run here against a real Worker, with the time each one takes measured as it happens.

lessons.blurb: Run both against the same three calls. Slow one down, make one fail, and watch where the time goes.
